crossRefs.note: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head…
Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his…
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For Yahweh has created a new thing in the earth: a woman…
She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there…

For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.
To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire…
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not just with braided…
instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly…
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

translations.web: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and sanctification with sobriety.
translations.bsb: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
translations.kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
translations.asv: but she shall be saved through her child-bearing, if they continue in faith and love and sanctification with sobriety.
